response.answer: Yinuo Wang and Xiaowen Tao are pioneering researchers in vision-driven locomotion for quadrupedal robots using deep reinforcement learning. They developed LocoMamba, which integrates vision and proprioception for efficient control. Their work focuses on Mamba models for state-space fusion.
